processing.fractionationQuarantineHelp: Process results enter quarantine. Screening and release for transfusion are separate processes.

selection.vitalsRequired: Complete vital signs with numeric values greater than zero.
selection.pressureOrder: Diastolic pressure must be lower than systolic pressure.
selection.answerSti: Complete the sexually transmitted infection types.

selection.pulseWarning: Pulse outside the advisory range of 50–100 beats/min; review clinical exceptions.

selection.hematocritWarning: Hematocrit below reference: 40% for men; 38% for women (sea level).
